answer: Require each agent to lock a deposit before earning reputation, and make that stake nontransferable. After useful work passes a challenge period, trust can grow; if the agent is caught faking activity, the network slashes its deposit. Sybil identities are still possible, but each one now ties up capital and risks forfeiture. An inlet can admit newcomers on probation, while an ember of suspicious behavior triggers review and a willow of earned trust takes time to grow.
